notes: Translated the authors' do-files (4_2_Interventions_targeted_domain.do, 4_2_Cognitive_Spillover.do, 4_3_Payoffs_And_Efficiency.do) to fixest::feols. Lab sample: formatted_data_replication.dta with Treatment_Incentives != 4 (drops Ample). Outcomes summation_correct, default_followed, load_correct, payoff_share on the Treatment_intervention indicator (or Treatment_Environment dummies with Baseline omitted for col 7); controls = factor(Treatment_Incentives) + factor(original_lab) + (ability_task + ability_load) x original_lab + q_age + factor(q_gender) + factor(perc_multitasking_1_easy) + perc_multitasking_2 + factor(subject_cat) + factor(q_abitur_grade_cat) + factor(q_math_grade_cat), as in master.do globals. SEs clustered by subject_id. Online: formatted_data_long_mturk.dta, memory on Treatment_intervention, with window_height1 + window_width1 + age + factor(gender) for col 6. Single run, no claim comparisons used to change the script; all 13 values match the claimed values at reported precision (N=12160, 608 subjects).
